items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and create no new site proposals or change requests this cycle. Evidence: 197 approved proposals lack execution requests, 46 failure follow-ups remain open, 29 deployed improvements await measurement, only 1 outcome is proven, and the authoritative candidate list is empty. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded compliance/security evidence work. Retain deferred site-product opportunities only where existing evidence supports them, including accessible CTA and information-hierarchy improvements, evidenced performance remediation, and clearer affiliate attribution; do not claim revenue or causal lift. Keep implementation within the existing approval and engineer queue.
